Please ask in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) about how the emoji renders in your terminal. The [Panel documentation](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/panel.rst) covers titles; emoji widths can vary across terminals, which can affect how a title fits. Include your terminal and Rich version when asking.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
